supportingSources.label: Cayle George at INDISC 2023 Classics II — Round 1

strategy.summary: Repeat the center loop, right orbit, and upper-left spinner sequence while the center-loop return and spinner rebound remain controlled.

steps.text: Shoot the center loop and settle its fast return on the left flipper.
From the left flipper, shoot the right orbit through the single drop target.
Let the right-orbit return reach the upper-right flipper, then shoot the upper-left spinner.
Settle the spinner rebound on either lower flipper. If the spinner rejects the shot, regain control before restarting the sequence.
Repeat the center loop, right orbit, and upper-left spinner while both returns remain controlled.

quickInfo.name: Primary scoring sequence
quickInfo.summary: The right orbit's single drop into the upper-left spinner is Car Hop's largest reliable scoring sequence.

quickInfo.name: ICE POPS
quickInfo.summary: Complete the popsicle drop targets shared across the left and right sides to collect the flashing ICE POP award.

quickInfo.name: Stock Ketchup
quickInfo.summary: On ball 3 in multiplayer, Ketchup can raise a trailing player's score to the leader's score; tournaments should use single-player unless Ketchup is disabled.

quickInfo.name: Nostalgia Mode
quickInfo.summary: Nostalgia Mode uses lower scoring values and replaces the modern audio with electromechanical-style chimes.

techniques.name: Early center-loop shimmy
techniques.instruction: Test a small, early nudge as the center loop starts its fast return. The goal is a slower feed that can be trapped on the left flipper. Stop if the tilt is tight.

cautions.issue: The center loop has a fast return that can arrive too quickly for a controlled trap.
cautions.response: Test the early shimmy on ball 1. Stop forcing the sequence if the return still reaches the left flipper out of control.

cautions.issue: The upper-left spinner can reject the shot.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready for the rebound. Do not assume the spinner will pass the ball safely.

cautions.issue: Center-post and inlane saves can consume tilt warnings during a long scoring loop.
cautions.response: Use the early feed nudge first. Reserve the larger center-post move for a ball that is already leaving the flippers.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At INDISC 2023, Cayle George repeatedly returned to the right-orbit drop and upper-left spinner; one clean spinner rip scored about ten million points.
At INDISC 2023 Classics II, Cayle George, Andy Bagwell, Eric Stone, and Colin MacAlpine repeatedly returned to the spinner; the random Ketchup award repeatedly changed match position.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Car Hop, shoot the center loop and settle its return on the left flipper. From there, shoot the right orbit through the single drop target, then use the upper-right flipper for the upper-left spinner. Settle the spinner rebound before repeating the sequence.
strategy.overview: In stock Car Hop, the center loop feeds the left flipper, the right orbit feeds the upper-right flipper, and the upper-left spinner completes the main repeatable scoring sequence. Settle each return before continuing. Complete the shared popsicle targets for ICE POPS only when their rebounds remain controlled.

quickInfo.name: Ketchup
quickInfo.summary: Ketchup always awards 1,000,000 instead of matching another player's score.

quickInfo.name: ICE POPS and HEAT WAVE
quickInfo.summary: Completing all ICE POPS scores 10,000,000, and HEAT WAVE always scores 30,000,000.

quickInfo.name: Points Round
quickInfo.summary: Successive Points Rounds score 2,000,000, then 4,000,000, then 8,000,000.
